text:
marta: Morning all — quick async check-in. What I did / blockers / today. Did: merged autoscaler tuning PR (#482). Blocker: seeing p95/p99 spikes on small-model paths. Today: validating new batcher config and collecting kernel traces. @raj can you help with trace collection?

raj: On it — will run the trace and attach link when done. Also finished updating the load-test script. To collect traces run: `curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/trace/start -d '{"job":"kernel-trace"}'` and then `curl .../stop`.

sam: Did: rolled canary for /generate to 3% traffic. No blocker. Today: monitoring metrics and will open a CR for a rollback guard (#490) — ping for review.

olivia: Heads-up: customer compliance audit next Tue. Did: updated onboarding docs for Private deploys. Blocker: need signoff on retention text. @marta can you review the retention policy section?

kevin: Infra note: disk cleanup + kernel patch scheduled tonight 02:00 UTC, may cause brief disruption on Dedicated hosts in us-west-2. Will post maintenance notice.

infra-bot: Reminder: maintenance window 2026-03-18T02:00Z — kernel patching on host-pool-west. Expected 5m disruption per node.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment complete: model-lite v2 at 3% traffic. Observability: latency delta +4ms, no errors.

sam: Quick ask: anyone able to do a 15m sync at 10:30 PT? If not, we can handle async here.

marta: I can join 10:30 PT. Raj + Olivia pls try to make it. Leaving checklist: - attach trace link - approve retention doc - CR #490 review.

raj: Trace uploaded: https://internal.redwood/trace/abc123 — added span notes and top-ops.

olivia: Retention doc PR: https://git.redwood/repo/docs/pull/112 — added suggested language and flagged the sections needing legal input.

kevin: Will post final maintenance notice in #incidents 30m prior and coordinate on-call.

marta: Thanks all :thumbsup: — if anything urgent pops up, DM me.
